summary:
# Digest: October 2026 operations report

- Orders shipped rose 6% to 41,280.
- Late shipments were 2.1% against a 1.5% target, mostly in the last week when
  the Leeds warehouse was one shift short.
- 1,930 support tickets, with a median first reply of 3 hours 10 minutes.
- Refunds were level with September at 312.

Decision needed: whether to add a temporary Leeds shift for November.
